spanish: Y al costado del mishkán el segundo, al lado de Tsafón, hizo veinte tablas,

findings.issue: mishkán leaves the common noun H4908 untranslated; a common noun must be Spanish
Tsafón transliterates and capitalizes the common noun north (H6828) as a proper name
The feminine ordinal modifies the side (צלע), but masculine el segundo stands after mishkán and marks a second tabernacle

notes: Y, al, costado, al lado de, hizo, veinte, and tablas match the remaining tokens.
